items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is actually Shirley Scott I think. [INTERVIEWEE] I know.

ctx.x: Well it sounds like the original was done by Little Esther. I did the original. Little Esther Phillips. “To Be Free.” Nina Simone — I did the first one with Nina in ’64.
This is actually Shirley Scott I think.
I know. I was coming to it. But I’m just trying to tell you—
